annotations.title: One holding across its whole range

description:
One holding already in the portfolio, measured at every weight from none to all, with
        the rest of the money shared out in proportion: volatility, the holding's
        share of the risk and the number of independent bets at each point. Use it for
        'how much of this is enough to change anything?'; for one specific change use
        test_a_change, for a holding not yet owned check_before_you_buy. ticker must
        be one of the holdings; base sets the currency (default USD). It never says
        which weight to hold.

base.description: Currency every figure is expressed in (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD…). Default USD.
base.title: Base

holdings.description: What is held: {ticker: weight or amount}. Weights need not sum to one; amounts in the base currency are also accepted (then the crises are shown in money). 1 to 100 holdings. Tickers as the exchange lists them (VOO, VWCE.DE, XAW.TO; 'CASH.USD' for cash).
holdings.title: Holdings

ticker.description: The holding to sweep; must be one of `holdings`.
ticker.title: Ticker

name: sweep_holding

outputSchema.description: One holding at every weight from none to all (counterfactual).

_fence.description: What these figures are and are not: descriptive, no forecast, no advice. Repeat its sense when presenting the result.

data.description: Where the prices came from and what was missing or repaired.

as_of.description: Last date of price history used.

missing.description: Tickers with no usable history (left out).

standins.description: Holdings measured through a stand-in with longer history: ticker, proxy, index, from, until, evidence.

knee.description: Weight below which most of the change happens, when there is one.

note.description: One sentence on where the change comes from.

points.description: Per weight: weight, vol (volatility), risk_share (that holding's share of the risk), effective_bets, top_factor_share.

redistribution.description: How the rest of the money is spread at each point.

total_change.description: Change in volatility from none to the current weight.

title: One holding across its whole range
